parts: Production cutout sheet for MARULUME, the BLUE DOLPHIN living-kite messenger in ref1, handmade flat folded-paper finish of Carcara ref2. Preserve blue dolphin identity: compact sky/cobalt blue body, ivory belly and small ivory long dolphin rostrum/muzzle with tiny friendly closed smile, dark small teal eyes not huge anime eyes, blue backward curving head crest/dorsal fin, small gold cord forehead band with tiny turquoise diamond, coral red folded ribbon tied behind head. Triangular BLUE/CYAN/IVORY KITE CHEST sail with bamboo perimeter gold knots and simple white wave motifs, not a separate kite carried. Two blue pectoral flippers/folded sail fins attached sides, each with white wave triangle motif and slim bamboo outer rib. Long flexible blue paper tail curling left down ending TWO dolphin flukes, a small cord knot near flukes. No legs or hands, no beak, no gills, not shark, not fish. THREE QUARTER RIGHT-facing poised floating silhouette, near eye larger far eye small. Flat angular paper facets 2-3 restrained tones, dark clean contour, no glossy 3D, no gradients/glow, discreet stitched repair on chest. Transparent portrait THREE COLUMNS THREE ROWS SHEET with generous empty gaps no grid/text. ROW1 col1 complete torso/head/crest/rostrum/headband/chest kite ONLY no flippers/tail, col2 complete NEAR pectoral sail flipper spread right root upper-left, col3 FAR flipper spread left root upper-right same anatomy slightly smaller. ROW2 col1 entire blue curved tail/flukes root upper-right, col2 fierce variant complete central torso/head, col3 hurt variant torso/head closed eyes. ROW3 col1 happy variant torso/head relaxed closed eyes, other slots EMPTY. ALL expression variants EXACT canonical pose/silhouette/muzzle/crest/headband/chest/nose/mouth and sizes; change ONLY eyes/brows. No open mouths. Every root solid closed overlappable, no holes. Do not add background props effects bubbles, no clipped fins. Match original blue/ivory/red/gold character with paper anatomy.
